game_text: Each player may, once per battle at a system, lose 1 Force to target two participating unique (•) piloted starships with immunity to attrition (one from each player); both starships lose all immunity to attrition this turn. When deploying to capital starships, your Mon Calamari pilots are deploy = 1.
